Q: Is n 0-based or 1-based, and is it counted per tool name or across all entries? Cite file#Lx-Ly of the indexing code.
A: n is 1-based and counted per tool name: the code counts results whose toolName equals Name and accepts 1 <= n <= count. Chronological order is per the doc comment. Entries of other tools are not counted toward the index.
Task: Determine how TaskManage resolves tool:Name#n evidence references in completion answers
